# ACTION PREP (verification) + assign/comment execution
my_email='jes.mill@gmail.com'

# ensure access_token
password=[a['password'] for a in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if a['account_name']=='todoist'][0]
access_token=apis.todoist.login(username=my_email, password=password)['access_token']

agreement_plan = [
    {'task_id': 2889, 'assignee_email': 'ca-smit@gmail.com', 'first_name': 'Catherine'},
    {'task_id': 2905, 'assignee_email': 'ch-burch@gmail.com', 'first_name': 'Christopher'},
    {'task_id': 2914, 'assignee_email': 'ka_ball@gmail.com', 'first_name': 'Katherine'},
    {'task_id': 2922, 'assignee_email': 'thomas.solomon@gmail.com', 'first_name': 'Thomas'},
]

# Verify current state before actions
before_state=[]
for item in agreement_plan:
    tid=item['task_id']
    t=apis.todoist.show_task(task_id=tid, access_token=access_token)
    before_assignee_email=t.get('assignee',{}).get('email')
    before_state.append((tid, before_assignee_email, t.get('is_completed'), t.get('title')))
print('BEFORE ASSIGNMENT STATE (task_id, assignee_email, is_completed, title):')
print(before_state)

# verify no appreciation comment exists yet

def has_appreciation_comment(tid):
    page_index=0
    page_limit=20
    while True:
        page=apis.todoist.show_task_comments(task_id=tid, access_token=access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
        if not page:
            return False
        for c in page:
            if 'Greatly appreciate it' in c.get('content',''):
                return True
        page_index += 1

app_comment_exists={}
for item in agreement_plan:
    tid=item['task_id']
    app_comment_exists[tid]=has_appreciation_comment(tid)
print('APPRECIATION COMMENT EXISTS?:', app_comment_exists)

# Do reassign + comment
assign_results=[]
for item in agreement_plan:
    try:
        r=apis.todoist.assign_or_unassign_task(task_id=item['task_id'], access_token=access_token, assignee_email=item['assignee_email'])
        assign_results.append((item['task_id'],'ok',r))
    except Exception as e:
        assign_results.append((item['task_id'],'fail',str(e)))
print('ASSIGN RESULTS:', [(tid,status) for tid,status,_ in assign_results])

comment_results=[]
for item in agreement_plan:
    content=f"Greatly appreciate it {item['first_name']}!"
    try:
        r=apis.todoist.post_task_comment(task_id=item['task_id'], content=content, access_token=access_token)
        comment_results.append((item['task_id'],'ok',r))
    except Exception as e:
        comment_results.append((item['task_id'],'fail',str(e)))
print('COMMENT RESULTS:', [(tid,status) for tid,status,_ in comment_results])

def fetch_all_comments(task_id):
    page_index=0
    page_limit=20
    allc=[]
    while True:
        page=apis.todoist.show_task_comments(task_id=task_id, access_token=access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
        if not page:
            break
        allc.extend(page)
        page_index+=1
    return allc

post_verification=[]
for item in agreement_plan:
    tid=item['task_id']
    t=apis.todoist.show_task(task_id=tid, access_token=access_token)
    assignee_email=t.get('assignee',{}).get('email')
    assignee_name=t.get('assignee',{}).get('name')
    comments=fetch_all_comments(tid)
    matching=[c for c in comments if c.get('content','').strip()==f"Greatly appreciate it {item['first_name']}!" ]
    post_verification.append({
        'task_id': tid,
        'task_title': t.get('title'),
        'assignee_email_after': assignee_email,
        'assignee_name_after': assignee_name,
        'expected_assignee_email': item['assignee_email'],
        'appreciation_comment_matches_count': len(matching),
        'latest_matching_created_at': max([c.get('created_at','') for c in matching], default=None)
    })
